title: JPMorgan Chase & Co. Form 8-K Current Report
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. filed a Form 8-K on April 24, 2026, disclosing amendments to the corporation's By-laws effective April 21, 2026. The amendments update advancement provisions in Article IX, specifically requiring that any advancement of fees or expenses comply with terms and conditions established by the corporation, which the corporation may amend or modify.
key_points: JPMorgan Chase's Board of Directors adopted bylaw amendments effective April 21, 2026
Amendments update 'advancement provisions' in Article IX of the By-laws
Advancement of fees or expenses must comply with terms and conditions set by the corporation
The corporation retains the right to amend or modify these terms and conditions
Full text of amended By-laws attached as Exhibit 3.2
Filed with SEC on April 24, 2026 by Corporate Secretary Reid R. Broda
why_it_matters: This filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure with no direct relevance to market structure or macro catalysts. It addresses only the procedural terms under which JPMorgan Chase may advance legal fees or expenses to officers/directors, which is a standard indemnification framework update.
